besluite.fout: 'wag dat' copies Dutch/English usage where Afrikaans says 'wag totdat' for 'wait until'
besluite.rede: This is the standard construction, the meaning stays the same (wait until someone sends it), no words are added, and it matches the 'gewag totdat' fix from the earlier round.
Putting 'vir jou' before the object is natural Afrikaans word order and does not read as 'your pages'; this is a lateral reordering of a shared glossary definition.
